funds_data.description: The Adviser primarily invests the assets of the fund among ETPs that provide exposure to five primary asset classes: (i) domestic and international equity securities; (ii) domestic and international investment-grade and high yield debt securities; (iii) hybrid equity/debt securities; (iv) first lien senior secured floating rate bank loans, commonly referred to as "Senior Loans"; and (v) REITs, including equity REITs and mortgage REITs.
